current.text: Philadelphia traded for him from Boston in a deal that sent Paul George away.
He is a projected starter next to Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, LeBron James and Joel Embiid.
His usage was a career-high 36% in Boston last season. Experts expect it to fall to about 27 to 30% because he now shares the ball with Maxey, Embiid and LeBron.
Experts expect his scoring to drop clearly from last season's 28.7 points. One preview expects the biggest scoring drop of any Sixers star.
His minutes should stay high or rise under Nick Nurse, with one projection at about 36. Experts expect his minutes and usage to go up when Embiid or LeBron miss games.

One preview expects him to have a harder time fitting in early than LeBron. It is unclear whether he can play off the ball or as a spot-up shooter. The team is expected to have growing pains in October and November.
Experts call him good value in the 35 to 45 range of category leagues. A 23 USD auction price was called a good buy, and he should not fall into the 60s. A top-20 ADP is too high.
The Sixers have 13 back-to-backs, and three of them fall in the fantasy playoffs.
Philadelphia is projected to win about 51 to 52 games. The preview also expects load management for the stars.

durable.text: Scoring is his main strength. He adds solid rebounds, assists, threes and steals, and his percentages are not ideal but do not hurt a team.
Turnovers are his clear weak category. His projected turnovers are a league outlier.
Experts say plain 9-cat rankings downgrade him too much and miss what he provides.
He is worth more in points leagues than in category leagues. Last season he ranked about 10th in points and about 25th in category leagues.
Experts disagree on his defense. One calls it a little overrated, and another calls him a more than solid defender.

note: Yahoo values him at 23 USD (average cost 22.9) but ESPN only at 7 USD, and he went for 29 USD in our league last season. Experts say about 23 USD is a good price because 9-cat rankings undervalue his scoring, rebounds and assists. His turnovers are a league outlier, so he fits a punt TO build best. Early in the season, check how much usage he keeps next to Maxey, Embiid and LeBron, and whether his minutes and shots rise when Embiid or LeBron sit.
